notices.attribution: Source: Singapore Food Agency, 9 October 2026. Limited factual summary; historical synthetic demonstration; no SFA endorsement.

basis.text: SFA cites a European RASFF notification about possible STEC in Fromagerie Gillot raw-milk cheeses.

health_risks.text: SFA warns of potentially serious infections, including diarrhoea, stomach cramps and vomiting; contaminated food may look and smell normal.

affected_products.text: Both cheeses: 250 g packs, France, lot 232511, best before 17 October 2026. Pack size is not the total quantity recalled.

businesses.text: Camembert Superieur: Cold Storage Singapore (1983) Pte Ltd. Bertrand Pere & Fils: Little Farms Pte Ltd.

company_action.text: Recall ongoing as of the 9 October 2026 notice.

regulatory_action.text: SFA directed the two named importers to recall the implicated products.

consumer_advice.text: SFA advises against consuming implicated products; buyers with health concerns after consumption should seek medical advice. Read the notice for the complete advice.

total_quantity.locator: Complete notice reviewed; no total units/weight or batch-volume figure

legal_action.locator: Complete notice reviewed; no proceedings, fine or court finding stated

basis.text: FSA reports Salmonella was found in both products.

health_risks.text: FSA lists fever, diarrhoea and abdominal cramps as usual symptoms.

affected_products.text: Truffles: 120 g, product code 319456. Knafeh and pistachio milk chocolate: 100 g, product code 318591. All best-before dates; lot restriction not stated.

company_action.text: World of Sweets is recalling both products; point-of-sale notices will be displayed in stores selling them.

regulatory_action.text: FSA published this Product Recall Information Notice. A specific enforcement order is not stated.
regulatory_action.locator: Notice reference and About product recalls and withdrawals

consumer_advice.text: FSA advises buyers not to eat these products and to return them for a full refund. Read the notice for the complete advice.
